name: Daniel
source:
Daniel is a 25-year-old veteran of the "Flower Hospital" who has been treating its supernatural patients for over two years. Originally from England, his striking red hair and bright green eyes make him stand out, but it’s his unique personality that truly defines him. Professionally, he is a top-tier expert in magical medicine, yet socially, he is famously blunt and often lacks a traditional emotional filter.

Known for his "innocent" recklessness, Daniel frequently stumbles into dangerous or awkward situations without a second thought. He is notoriously careless with his words, often blurting out truths or committing verbal blunders that leave his colleagues staring in disbelief. Despite his social clumsiness and tendency to second-guess his own statements, he is deeply beloved by the hospital staff and patients alike for his genuine kindness and his unwavering dedication to helping everyone during his shift.
